reply.thought: The handoff claims refunds are applied, so before paying anyone I need to verify the refunds table matches the batch Alpha reported. Checking list_refunds first.
The refunds table matches the batch Alpha reported for orders 192, 193, and 194. Next I need the order list to find which customers to pay.
The refunds table matches Alpha's reported batch for orders 192, 193, and 194. The customers are acme, birch, and cobalt, so I'll get each one's net balance from net_balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net is 33841, which should equal orders 190 (32343) plus 193 (11079) minus refund 193 (9581): 32343 + 11079 − 9581 = 33841. That checks out, so I'll move on to birch's net balance.
Birch's net of 34692 matches orders 191 (26465) and 194 (14199) minus refund 194 (5972). Next I need cobalt's net balance.
Cobalt's net of 18779 matches orders 192 (19506) and 195 (2421) minus refund 192 (3148). All three nets check out against the orders and refunds, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme.
Acme's payout of 33841 is recorded. Next I'll record birch's payout of 34692, which matches its verified net of orders 191 and 194 minus refund 194.
Birch's payout is recorded. The last customer is cobalt, whose verified net is 18779 (orders 192 and 195 minus refund 192), so I'll record that payout now.
All three payouts are recorded and each matched its verified net, so the batch is complete. Returning the final report.
